svg.title: Solo verification scenes: one verified contract, its neighbours as CVL models
svg.desc: Solo verification scenes shown as cards, the rate model scenes among them. In every card the contract tagged REAL BYTECODE · SUBJECT OF THE SCENE is the one the scene verifies, and it runs as real compiled bytecode. A dashed box is a CVL model standing in for a neighbour: it returns values and never calls out. The IrmConfigFactory card also shows the config templates the factory deploys, which run as real bytecode. Arrows always start at a real contract. Small chips along the bottom of a card name what the scene models without a node: tokens, oracle and IRM on a market card; on a rate model card, the router that calls it and the market it prices.
